Business Account Update
!%UserFirstName%!,
This notice is to inform you that an individual has modified the options for sharing Intel® Partner Alliance programme information with the selected Intel® Authorised Distributors and/or Intel® Approved Suppliers (Service Providers).
Business Account Name: !%AccountName%! Account Number: !%AccountNumber%! Primary Contact Who Made the Selection(s): !%UserEmailAddr%! Date: !%DateSigned%! Service Provider(s) Selected: !%Distributors%! Authorisation: I hereby authorise Intel to share with the Service Provider(s) information about my Intel® Technology Provider Programme account to help manage my benefits. I also authorise Intel to allow them to make points redemptions on my behalf (not available in APJ).
If you do not approve of this action or feel that an error has been made, you can modify the selections or opt out. If you have any questions, please contact us at programs@intel.com.
Thank you, Your Intel® Partner Alliance team
This message was sent to you as an important business communication related to your current relationship with Intel® Partner Alliance. © {!Contact.Core_Current_Year__c} Intel Corporation Intel Corporation, 2200 Mission College Blvd., M/S RNB4-145, Santa Clara, CA 95054 USA. www.intel.com Privacy | Cookies
